gen_risks.description: Risk of budget duplication or financial reporting overlap due to using the shared AMO-TADAMON budget line across multiple World Bank-financed operations.
gen_risks.mitigation: Establish distinct budget codes within the MoI budget specifically supporting PBC-related activities and enforce strict financial monitoring.
gen_risks.evidence: risk of duplication or overlap due to the use of the same budget line “AMO-TADAMON” to justify expenditure

gen_risks.description: Reliance on manual Excel spreadsheets and data extraction from budget software may cause quality and timeliness challenges in preparing Interim Financial Reports (IFRs).
gen_risks.mitigation: Develop and install dedicated financial management software to automate IFR preparation and annual project financial statement generation.
gen_risks.evidence: use of a spreadsheet “Excel” and data extracted from the national budget execution software may lead to some challenges

gen_risks.description: Rapid expansion of the NPR and SR registries strains government capacity, risking delays in operationalizing the National Registry Agency (NRA).
gen_risks.mitigation: Provide institutional capacity building and structure PBC disbursements to incentivize the timely appointment of key NRA staff and governance adoption.
gen_risks.evidence: rapid expansion has strained the government’s and the MoI’s capacity to take steps in operationalizing the NRA.

gen_risks.description: Vulnerable groups including persons with disabilities, illiterate individuals, and remote residents face potential social exclusion due to registration barriers.
gen_risks.mitigation: Deploy mobile registration units, satellite equipment, local Citizen Service Centers, and execute inclusive communication strategies under the Stakeholder Engagement Plan.
gen_risks.evidence: exclusion of some vulnerable groups due to inefficient or inadequate public communication and outreach efforts

gen_risks.description: Workers in the informal sector may resist enrolling in registries due to perceived fears of becoming visible to taxation authorities.
gen_risks.mitigation: Conduct proactive communication and outreach campaigns highlighting registration benefits and clarifying data segregation between social targeting and tax administration.
gen_risks.evidence: workers in the informal sector, are wary of providing their information to the government due to perceived risks

gen_risks.description: Data protection breaches or privacy concerns regarding personal biographic and biometric data could impair public trust in digital identity systems.
gen_risks.mitigation: Implement privacy-by-design architectures, strictly adhere to national data protection Law 09-08, and fund software development for enhanced data security.
gen_risks.evidence: Potential negative social impacts from project activities are mainly related to... data protection issues.

gen_risks.description: Deployment of mobile registration units and electronic hardware risks generating e-waste without appropriate disposal mechanisms.
gen_risks.mitigation: Enforce sustainable procurement standards and apply e-waste management procedures under the MoI asset management framework.
gen_risks.evidence: Risks associated with the use of electronic devices (such as mobile units) include the potential generation of e-waste

gen_risks.description: Inaccuracies or unreliability in income data cross-checking with administrative files could lead to targeting errors in household welfare scoring.
gen_risks.mitigation: Conduct formal studies on income data reliability, test updated questionnaires on representative samples, and recalibrate the scoring formula.
gen_risks.evidence: evaluating the reliability of the data cross-checking system with administrative files used to validate the information

gen_risks.description: Transferring registry management from MoI to the newly established NRA poses institutional, legal, and operational transition challenges.
gen_risks.mitigation: Define clear operational procedures in the Project Operations Manual and secure approval from the Inter-ministerial Steering Committee prior to management transfer.
gen_risks.evidence: putting in place a new institution... while establishing and rolling out these systems at the same time is challenging.

gen_risks.description: Failure or delay in automatically capturing deceased individuals in the NPR undermines system accuracy and creates potential ghost records.
gen_risks.mitigation: Establish an automated, direct data exchange system between civil registry offices (BEC) and the NPR to capture all deceased flow.
gen_risks.evidence: removal of deceased registrants is equally important to ensure sustained efficiency.

gen_risks.description: Recurrent drought and climatic shocks threaten household living standards, overwhelming social protection targeting systems if data is not dynamic.
gen_risks.mitigation: Leverage NPR location data and SR dynamic updating protocols to enable rapid identification and adaptive assistance for climate-affected populations.
gen_risks.evidence: Climate-related shocks, primarily droughts, represent significant risks to the Moroccan economy.

gt_risks.description: Stakeholder risk is assessed as Substantial. Given the complex nature of the operation and the involvement of multiple stakeholders in the implementation of the National Population Register (NPR) and the Social Registry (SR), the Project Management Unit (PMU) will need to put considerable effort into ensuring better coordination to achieve the PDO. The national rollout and the improvement of the NPR and the SR will need strong stakeholder engagement, including citizens concerned by social protection programs who are often poor and vulnerable.
gt_risks.mitigation: The communication strategy will continue to inform all stakeholders involved in project implementation and will capitalize on lessons learned from the first Identity and Targeting for Social Protection project (P155198). The PMU envisions improving the grievance mechanism at local and national levels and establishing a system to promote citizen engagement and transparency. The Inter-Ministerial Steering Committee is responsible for developing guidelines for the strategic policy for the envisaged reform and ensuring a link with the ongoing social protection reform. Technical work will also cover a process evaluation to identify challenges, propose remedies, and provide recommendations to enhance system implementation at central and local levels.
